predictions.selection_reason: Constructs server request with 'substitute' parameter -> controls server-side image processing behavior -> potential for resource exhaustion or injection
predictions.source_summary: substituteImg is derived from fm.option('substituteImg', file.hash) && file.size > options.dimSubImgSize; file.hash comes from selected file; options are configuration settings
predictions.sink_summary: fm.request() sends data to server-side 'dim' command handler which processes image dimensions and substitute image generation
predictions.guard_summary: Conditional based on file.size > options.getDimThreshold; substituteImg requires both configuration option and file size threshold; server-side validation in PHP elFinderVolumeDriver::dimensions()
predictions.risk_pattern: Client constructs server request with 'substitute' parameter controlling server-side image processing; when substituteImg=true, sends numeric value 400, otherwise empty string; server may interpret this as image dimension for substitute generation
predictions.context_summary: In image resize dialog initialization, sends dimension request to server; substitute parameter controls whether server generates substitute image with specified size (400px) or empty for no substitution
unresolved_facts: Exact server-side processing of substitute parameter value
Whether substitute value 400 is validated/sanitized server-side
Potential impact of manipulated substitute parameter on server resources

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: client-side image processing request with substitute parameter controlling server-side resource generation
retrieval_query.sensitive_operation: server-side image dimension processing and substitute image generation
retrieval_query.missing_control: validation of substitute parameter value for resource consumption limits

top_sast_rules.description: Processing user-controlled object hierarchies inefficiently can lead to denial of service.
